dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: One complete 'O' shaped annulus at the mid-ventral boundary featuring a bright, jagged perimeter; one 'C' shaped hook structure positioned anterior to the 'O'; and a large irregular 'C' enclosure at the mid-dorsal ridge with a sharp light-to-dark gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low overall density of solid pixel clusters; primary high-intensity features are linear. Localized concentrations of high-intensity pixels are observed at the extreme anterior point and in small, non-gradient specks along the lower flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the 'O' annulus, 'C' hook, and the mid-dorsal loop form a scalene triangle with the longest side extending along the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, jagged, meandering high-contrast line resembling a fractal boundary that spans the mid-section of the visible body.
